posts.text: I've recently started hiding the bulk of my AI-generated GitHub PR descriptions behind a collapsed <details><summary> HTML tag (thankfully supported by GitHub Markdown) and I think it's a useful pattern for making PR slop a little bit less exhausting

posts.text: ... today I learned that Twitter preview cards can't handle HTML tags in post titles!
